about: Machine-readable index of the Job Catalog, generated from data.json. data.json is the source of truth and is not modified.

files.index.json: Summary: schema id, generation time, source hash, counts, categories with subcategories, countries, regions.
files.index.jsonl: One catalog source per line (JSON object, same item fields as below).
files.catalog.html: Human page, works offline, search and filters.
files.mindmap.html: Offline mind map of categories and subcategories (Mermaid).

index_json_fields.source: Path, sha256, size and counts of data.json; modified=false means data.json was only read.
index_json_fields.counts: Totals: items, categories, subcategories, items_with_country, remote_items, items_without_subcategory_in_source, doubtful_subcategories.
index_json_fields.categories: Array of {id, name, color, count, subcategories:[{id,name,count,source}]}; source=data means the subcategory exists in data.json, source=view means it was added for display.
index_json_fields.countries: Array of {name, count}, derived from tags.
index_json_fields.regions: Array of {name, count}, derived from country tags and the Remote/EU tags.

item_fields.name: Original name from data.json.
item_fields.display_name: Name plus country for humans; display-only.
item_fields.subcategory: Original sub id, or a view-only id when data.json has none.
item_fields.subcategory_source: data = present in data.json; view = added for display only.
item_fields.doubtful_subcategory: true when the subcategory was added in the view, not present in data.json.
item_fields.regions: Regions derived from country tags and Remote/EU (display-only).
item_fields.remote: true when the Remote tag is present.
item_fields.login: true when the Login tag is present.
item_fields.freelance: true when the Freelance tag is present.

notes: Every source from data.json is present; nothing is dropped.
Display-only fields never change data.json; consumers that need the original data should read data.json.
URLs are kept exactly as in data.json (only trimmed of surrounding spaces).
